newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-COSTA HAS SAMPRAS NEXT AFTER FERREIRA RETIRES.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-COSTA HAS SAMPRAS NEXT AFTER FERREIRA RETIRES.

text.p: Spanish 10th seed Albert Costa booked a place in the Australian Open quarter-finals on Monday when eighth seed Wayne Ferreira of South Africa retired from their match with a leg injury.
Costa was leading 6-3 6-2 3-2 when Ferreira, the world number 10, quit the match after one hour and 17 minutes.
Costa's quarter-final opponent will be world number one Pete Sampras, who beat Slovakia's Dominik Hrbaty earlier on Monday.
Costa is the third Spaniard through to the men's quarter-finals. Baseliners Carlos Moya and Felix Mantilla, the 14th seed, won their fourth round matches on Sunday.
